purpose: Define schema as explicit semantic shape owned by the defining Meta/contract, with deterministic field requirements and no hidden schema inference from examples or payloads.

topics.name: Schema
topics.purpose: Define schema as explicit semantic shape owned by the defining Meta/contract, with deterministic field requirements and no hidden schema inference from examples or payloads.

semantics.schema_rule: Schema defines allowed fields, required fields, value constraints and reference shapes explicitly.
semantics.unknown_field_rule: Boundary unknown fields are rejected unless the owning schema explicitly permits extension.
semantics.example_rule: Examples illustrate schema but do not define missing schema semantics.
semantics.payload_rule: Observed payload shape does not mutate or extend canonical schema.
semantics.ownership_rule: Schema semantics belong to their explicit semantic owner, commonly the owning Meta/domain contract.
semantics.version_rule: Breaking schema semantics follow semantic identity/versioning rules.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant semantics are explicit and deterministic.

hard_gates.condition: example data treated as authoritative schema
unknown field silently accepted without explicit extension semantics
breaking schema change hidden under unchanged semantic identity

references.purpose: Breaking schema change follows semantic version/identity rules.
